note: Generic instrument categories found in plate-bending sets, not a vendor
catalogue. Add your department's kit here with its own instrument names so
the generated steps read the way your set is labelled.
bending_insets says whether this kit fits inserts into the threaded holes
while the plate is contoured. AO Surgery Reference: without them the holes
deform during contouring and precise seating of locking screws cannot be
guaranteed. hole_protection is the fraction of that deformation the kit
removes; 0 means the holes take the strain unprotected.
bend_localisation_mm is the arc length over which the instrument spreads a
bend: a small number is a tight local kink, a large one a broad curve.

kits.name: Bending irons (two-handled pair)
kits.marking: Mark the bar with a sterile marker at the distance given, on the outer face.
kits.notes: Grip either side of the mark and close the handles; take the angle in passes rather than one pull.
kits.signature: A broad, even curve. The wide grip spreads the bend over roughly a screw-hole pitch, so no single point takes it all — but any hole inside the grip is strained with the bar unless insets are fitted.

kits.name: Three-point bending pliers
kits.marking: Centre the middle jaw on the mark.
kits.notes: Good for fine contouring between screw holes; keep the jaws clear of the holes themselves.
kits.signature: A tight, local kink at the middle jaw. Precise between holes, and the worst offender through one: the bend is concentrated into a few millimetres.

kits.name: Bar bending press
kits.marking: Set the mark against the press index line.
kits.notes: For thick bars that will not move with hand instruments.
kits.signature: A smooth, repeatable arc with the holes held by press insets. The most predictable result and the kindest to threaded holes; least able to make a fine local adjustment.

kits.name: Plate twisting forceps (pair)
kits.marking: Mark both ends of the span to be twisted.
kits.notes: Grip either side of the span and rotate in opposite directions.
kits.signature: A twist distributed along the gripped span. Holes inside the span are sheared rather than stretched, which skews them into a rhomboid instead of an oval.

kits.name: Malleable template wire and transfer
kits.marking: Lay the wire on the printed template and follow it by hand.
kits.notes: Shape the wire to the printed template first, then copy the wire onto the plate.
kits.signature: Freehand. Very smooth, entirely operator-dependent, and the hardest to reproduce; the bend distributes over a long span so individual holes see little strain.
